source.scope: Broader non-FrameXML 12.1 behavioral fidelity boundaries excluded from the 432-row symbol snapshot.
source.normalization: Each independently testable behavior is a changed occurrence grouped by the existing eight audit families.

candidate_states.note: Candidate states guide re-triage only. Machine status remains neutral until focused evidence or item-specific exception approval exists.

occurrences.detail: Addon-tainted UnitAura and aura access raise the retail secret-value error shape.
Blizzard/internal callers receive the permitted secret-aura behavior distinct from addon-tainted callers.
Fully secret AuraData fields remain inaccessible to addons while preserving the retail object shape.
Secret UNIT_AURA payload values preserve retail secrecy and tuple shape.
Private or forbidden objects have identity distinct from their public frame view.
Private keys remain inaccessible through the public object.
Public traversal cannot expose forbidden or private children.
Hooks cannot cross private or forbidden partitions except through permitted delegates.
Script handlers stored in private partitions are not publicly readable or writable.
Public delegates invoke permitted private behavior without exposing private receiver state.
Operations requiring trusted script execution reject insecure callers.
Layout-script operations reject insecure callers lacking the required aspect.
Event registration operations enforce the EventRegistrations aspect restriction.
Input propagation changes enforce the AlwaysPropagateInput aspect restriction.
Scripted-input operations enforce the ScriptedInput aspect restriction.
Focus-query operations enforce the QueryFocus aspect restriction.
AuraContainer, AuraButton, and ManagedAuraContainer can be created with compatible object types.
Aura data can be assigned to container and button objects with compatible ownership.
Helpful, harmful, and player filters select a compatible aura subset.
Aura entries use a documented compatible ordering.
Public and private aura data lands in the compatible object partition.
Managed containers create, reuse, and release aura buttons compatibly.
Aura buttons bind compatible aura tooltip data.
Secret aura values remain hidden while container and button structure stays usable.
A created Texture exposes the radial method family; no standalone constructor or object claim is made.
Radial progress methods dispatch on a Texture receiver.
Texture-backed radial progress defaults, setters/getters, visual mode, and Clear reset are modeled.
A binding remains usable while retained by Lua references; exact Blizzard ownership and invalidation semantics remain unproven.
Factory calls return distinct Lua tables with stable object identity and method lookup while referenced.
The binding type, metatable, userdata representation, finalization, and ownership match Blizzard exactly.
Duration formatting and interpolation use the documented compatible contract.
Color-curve methods preserve compatible binding state.
The binding updates a FontString through a documented compatible lifetime and update contract.
Discord authorization and refresh state transitions expose compatible result payloads.
Discord guild link, unlink, and setting operations expose compatible state payloads.
Discord server and channel lists, names, counts, and linkable-channel payloads are compatible.
Owned-house and plot state plus ResetHouse behavior follow the local compatibility model.
Housing blueprint export, import, and share-code payloads follow the local compatibility model.
Housing availability and result codes plus import validation follow the local compatibility model.
Housing editor, decor, room, budget, and floorplan payloads follow the local compatibility model.
Verified Battle.net friend invite creation, deduplication, and info fields follow the local compatibility model.
Battle.net title-friend custom names, tags, feature flags, and appear-offline state follow the local compatibility model.
Battle.net title-friend unit invite eligibility uses a documented deterministic compatibility result.
Encounter Journal base and valid difficulty IDs follow generated instance-data guesses.
Cooldown query structures, secret fields, and update payloads follow a documented compatibility contract.
Pet-related structures and state payloads follow a documented compatibility contract.
LFG service-result structures follow a documented compatibility contract.
Player-choice structures, options, and state payloads follow a documented compatibility contract.
C_DelvesUI TieredEntranceTierInfo rows expose tier, suggestedILvl, unlocked, tierDescription, modifierUIWidgetSetID, lockedReason, and rewards containing id, quantity, rewardType, and context.
Private-aura payloads preserve inaccessible and secret structural boundaries.
Removed APIs are absent from addon-facing globals before Blizzard startup completes.
Pinned Blizzard UI loads while required removed symbols remain temporarily available.
Removed symbols are hidden from addon-facing checks after startup.
Deprecated wrappers remain available exactly until their required Blizzard callers finish.
